NewsArticle.Title: Shift Faith; Identify
NewsArticle.Content:
You may shift your faith to an allied diety. To do so,
- Worship devoutly to increase your faith, until you are able to Shift Faith under your Fellowship menu.
- Tell your trusted priest which allied diety you wish to shift to.
- Your priest, not you, will decide. Be sure you trust your priest.
Rogues may now identify any item by going to the Higgler, and attempting to 'Higgle'. See the Higgler for details.
Wizards may analyze any item by research. It takes some time though. Go to Dar's laboratory for details.
